full_page.content:
1935, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 304 Cont.
Feb. Mrs. Mary D. Trump - 55 - Cyst on breast - bothered now 6 yrs. - opened four times.
Mrs. Mazzara - 28 -Goiter - 3 child'n
Agnes Perin - 18 - Sten. & secret'y - has widowed mother & 3 to support ...
Joseph Bayer - 35 - very hard of hearing - parents dead - neglected - never made First Hol. Communion - would like to do so - lives a- lone - formerly an iron worker.
Fred C. Benstein - 33 - Spiritest - inward goiter ..... Enrolled To- day $5.
Rose McCarthy - 74 - operation - gall-stones - went to Hospt'1 this p.m.
Rev. Edw'd J. Taylor.
Blank Page
Page 305 Page 306 Feb. Rose McCarthy - 79 - Operation for gall stones last Wednesday - for whom prayers were asked - improving very remarkably. Seemingly a hopeless case before operation - now very hopeful.
Mrs. Edna Gabrish - Mother of seven - youngest 1 yr. old - Quite paralysed since ... was speechless but improving of late but last October got bad set-back by falling down cellar receiving fractured skull.
Therese Reid - Scarlet Fev. - 10 - · Mrs. Weisner -- sinking - 6 small ch.
13 Anna Broderick - about 23 - ... killed in auto accident Feb.
18 Anna Hook - 75 - gall - trouble
20 Stanislaus Wierzbicki - 15 - Epileptic fits for 4 yrs, five & 6 times a week - some days 3 times. Was enrolled in Ser. Mass Assoc'n last Thursday A.M. after spending all night (nearly) in convulsions. Has not had any fits since. They ask prayers in thanksgiving and that the cure may prove permanent - promises to enroll perpetually as soon as next pay-day comes.
